name: Moneta
oneLiner: USDM is a Cardano dollar token issued independently by Moneta and NBX, with separate reserve books and issuer-attributed redemption obligations.
collateral: Separate USD reserve books: Moneta bank deposits and money market funds managed by Fidelity and Western Asset Management; NBX deposits at Sparebanken Norge and Amundi USD money market funds. Neither issuer's reserve backs the other's issuance.
pegMechanism: Par USD redemption against the responsible issuer, subject to KYC and issuer-attribution checks. Moneta's current bank-wire rail is limited to KYB-approved institutions; its FAQ states a default $10,000 daily mint/burn limit and a 0.1% burning fee with a $50 minimum and $5,000 cap, including Cardano network fees but excluding possible bank fees. NBX redeems its own attributable issuance from its separate reserve; Moneta-attributable USDM presented to NBX is redeemable only from settled Moneta funds already received. Mixed or unresolved attribution can delay processing. An independent reserve-verification oracle gates minting on Cardano; the latest NBX whitepaper does not name the current provider.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Moneta's official fundamentals notice states that USDM went live on Cardano mainnet for institutional partners on March 16, 2024 and identifies the policy ID that matches the tracked asset. Its direct 1:1 fiat-reserve issuance and redemption design supports the fiat-cash archetype.
